svg.metadata:
import pyagrum as gum
bn = gum.BayesNet("Monty Hall")
bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("your choice", "The door you pick first", ["door 1", "door 2", "door 3"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("car", "Where the car is", ["door 1", "door 2", "door 3"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("host opens", "The door the host opens", ["door 1", "door 2", "door 3"]))
bn.addArc("car", "host opens") bn.addArc("your choice", "host opens")
bn.cpt("your choice").fillWith([0.333333333333, 0.333333333333, 0.333333333333])
bn.cpt("car").fillWith([0.333333333333, 0.333333333333, 0.333333333333])
bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 1", "your choice": "door 1"}] = [0, 0.5, 0.5] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 1", "your choice": "door 2"}] = [0, 0, 1] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 1", "your choice": "door 3"}] = [0, 1, 0] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 2", "your choice": "door 1"}] = [0, 0, 1] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 2", "your choice": "door 2"}] = [0.5, 0, 0.5] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 2", "your choice": "door 3"}] = [1, 0, 0] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 3", "your choice": "door 1"}] = [0, 1, 0] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 3", "your choice": "door 2"}] = [1, 0, 0] bn.cpt("host opens")[{"car": "door 3", "your choice": "door 3"}] = [0.5, 0.5, 0]
# Node positions for the visual editor (ignored by pyAgrum). # bn-editor-layout: {"your choice":[180,90],"car":[460,90],"host opens":[320,240]}
# Evidence set in the editor. With it, pyAgrum computes the probabilities the editor shows. ie = gum.LazyPropagation(bn) ie.setEvidence({"your choice": "door 3"}) ie.makeInference() # bn-editor-evidence: {"your choice":"door 3"}
